title: Online antisemitism across platforms
models_tested: Custom lexicon-based Explainable AI system by Textgain
findings: The AI system found that antisemitic content varies significantly across platforms, with much higher prevalence on less-moderated, alt-right platforms like Gab (7.5%) and 8chan (15.0%) compared to mainstream platforms like Twitter and Facebook. The study links the rise in online antisemitism to conspiracy theories like QAnon, reviving Nazi-era rhetoric and antisemitic concepts such as 'blood libel'. For instance, QAnon-related posts on Twitter in 2020 were found to be 3% antisemitic, a significant increase from the <0.1% baseline on Twitter/Facebook in 2015.
